visualBrief: Seville’s fortified Lion Gate, the Mudéjar Palace of Pedro I above the Patio de las Doncellas, Gothic Palace, and the garden galleries at the Mercury Pool.
limitations: Exterior model of the core palace, Lion Gate, principal courtyards, Mercury Pool and Galería de los Grutescos. The secondary gardens and city buildings stay with their native map layers.
Court and building elevations use standard Terrarium samples with local steps and terraces. Tile work, ornament and sculpture are interpreted from photographs at World Viewer scale.
Interior rooms, the underground baths and the enclosed upper royal apartments are outside this model.

photoFacing.frontBasis: The named PMTiles Lion Gate, Patio de las Doncellas, Crucero and Mercury Pool identify the orientation and position of the main range. Individual courtyard wings follow their footprint bearings.

terrain: Bilinear six-meter sampling from standard zoom-15 Terrarium tiles.
